searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he phase two — gevurah critique the awtsmoos is not impressed by motion without measure; awtsmoos.com becomes cleaner when each tempting shortcut is cut away like false treasure. twenty improvements to phase one 1. do not assume modules/player/core.js creates visible controls;
